  1. Components

Components

The chart installs seven upstream KServe charts as pinned dependencies plus its own workload templates.

What each component provides

Component Installs Disable when
kserveCrd Core CRDs: InferenceService, ServingRuntime, ClusterServingRuntime, TrainedModel, InferenceGraph CRDs are managed by a separate release or cluster administrator
llmisvcCrd LLMInferenceService and LLMInferenceServiceConfig CRDs You never deploy LLMInferenceService workloads
localModelCrd Local model cache CRDs You do not use node-local caching
kserve Core controller, webhooks, storage initializer configuration, shared inferenceservice-config Another release already runs the core controller
llmisvc The LLMInferenceService controller You only deploy classic InferenceService workloads
localModel Local model controller and node agent You do not use node-local caching
runtimeConfigs The built-in ClusterServingRuntimes You supply your own runtimes only

Default configuration 

components:
  kserveCrd:
    enabled: true
  llmisvcCrd:
    enabled: true
  localModelCrd:
    enabled: true
  kserve:
    enabled: true
  llmisvc:
    enabled: true
  localModel:
    enabled: true
  runtimeConfigs:
    enabled: true

Shared resources

kserve-resources and kserve-llmisvc-resources both can create the shared inferenceservice-config ConfigMap, cert-manager issuer, and webhook objects. Exactly one owner is required.

The chart defaults are correct and should not be inverted:

kserve-resources:
  kserve:
    createSharedResources: true

kserve-llmisvc-resources:
  kserve:
    createSharedResources: false

If you disable components.kserve but keep components.llmisvc, move ownership:

components:
  kserve:
    enabled: false

kserve-llmisvc-resources:
  kserve:
    createSharedResources: true

Common component profiles

LLM serving only

Skips the classic predictive controller and built-in runtimes.

components:
  kserveCrd:
    enabled: true
  llmisvcCrd:
    enabled: true
  localModelCrd:
    enabled: false
  kserve:
    enabled: true
  llmisvc:
    enabled: true
  localModel:
    enabled: false
  runtimeConfigs:
    enabled: false

clusterServingRuntimes:
  openVINO:
    enabled: false
  vllmCPU:
    enabled: false

Keep components.kserve enabled unless another release owns the shared resources. The LLM controller depends on them.

Predictive serving only 

components:
  llmisvcCrd:
    enabled: false
  llmisvc:
    enabled: false
  localModelCrd:
    enabled: false
  localModel:
    enabled: false

CRDs managed separately

Useful when a cluster administrator installs CRDs and application teams install controllers.

components:
  kserveCrd:
    enabled: false
  llmisvcCrd:
    enabled: false
  localModelCrd:
    enabled: false

Install the CRDs first:

helm install kserve-crd oci://ghcr.io/kserve/charts/kserve-crd --version v0.20.0 -n kserve

Configuring the core controller 

kserve-resources:
  kserve:
    controller:
      image: kserve/kserve-controller
      tag: v0.20.0
      resources:
        requests:
          cpu: 100m
          memory: 300Mi
        limits:
          cpu: 500m
          memory: 1Gi
      nodeSelector:
        kubernetes.io/os: linux
      tolerations: []
      affinity: {}
    storage:
      image: kserve/storage-initializer
      tag: v0.20.0
      resources:
        limits:
          cpu: "1"
          memory: 2Gi
    certManager:
      enabled: true

Configuring the LLM controller 

kserve-llmisvc-resources:
  kserve:
    createSharedResources: false
    llmisvc:
      controller:
        image: kserve/llmisvc-controller
        tag: v0.20.0
        replicas: 1
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 500Mi

Verifying component state 

helm get values model-serving -n kserve
kubectl get deploy -n kserve
kubectl get crd | grep kserve.io
kubectl get clusterservingruntime
